app.name: Inngest
app.one_liner: A workflow orchestration platform that enables developers to build durable, event-driven step functions with built-in retries, concurrency control, and state management without managing infrastructure.

screens.name: Function Dashboard
screens.purpose: View and manage durable functions, their triggers, steps, and execution status.

rust_commands.name: invoke_step
rust_commands.purpose: Execute a single step within a durable function, with automatic retry on failure.

rust_commands.name: register_function
rust_commands.purpose: Sync a function definition with the Inngest platform or self-hosted server for execution.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build local dev server with production parity
week 1: Implement core durable step execution with retry logic
week 1: Support event and cron triggers
acceptance_tests: A function with two steps retries each step independently on failure and completes successfully after transient errors.
Concurrency limit of 10 per user ID prevents more than 10 simultaneous executions for the same user.
